The softmax Jacobian integration proves all-pair upper bounds, while finite scores approach equal two-atom boundary probabilities and infinitesimal mincut directions give the sharp supremum. For lambda>=2 degree sum <=2(n-1) yields strict n/4 bound; for a bridge, degree sum <=n with equality exactly for two boundary vertices universal on their own sides. Tree and K_ab formulas follow from pair connectivities. This proof, not finite graphs, covers all n, positive weights and real inputs.
